FQHESphereCP2ConvertSymmetrizedState, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereCP2ConvertSymmetrizedState [options]

system options:

    --tzZ3symmetrized-basis : use Tz <-> -Tz and Z3 permutations symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-tz=0 and total-y = 0)
    --minus-tzparity : select the  Tz <-> -Tz symmetric sector with negative parity

output options:
